sentences.en: The punch on the jaw brought me to my knees.
sentences.zh: 一记重击打在下巴上，让我跪倒在地。

sentences.en: His answer was a hard punch on the nose.
sentences.zh: 他的回答是对着鼻子的一拳。

sentences.en: He received a tremendous punch on the jaw from his opponent.
sentences.zh: 对手给他的下巴来了个巨大的重击。

senses.zh: 按(键)；以拳重击；开洞；剪票
